title: Paradise on Coral Reef
shortDescription: Andaman Islands are undoubtedly the best tourism destination of India specially for those who love nature.
description: Andaman Islands are undoubtedly the best tourism destination of India specially for those who love nature. Warm ocean water, white sanded unspoilt beaches, enjoy complete isolation and unmatched peace in this beautiful abode. Spend 3 Nights in Port Blair and experience nature at its awesome best.

About 38 Kms away from Port Blair, explore the stunning beauty of Havelock Island and dive into the warm sea waters to explore the awe-striking coral reef. It is an idyllic resort in the lap of virgin beaches and unpolluted environment.
